name: Review a pull request in GitHub
description: Run the Pull Request Reviewer agent against a specific GitHub pull request. The workflow links the PR to a task on the board (idempotently, by a stable external reference) and hands it to the pull-request-reviewer agent, which reads the diff and changed files via the GitHub connector (get_pull_request_diff / get_pull_request_files) and posts a structured review (create_pull_request_review — APPROVE / REQUEST_CHANGES / COMMENT) plus any inline comments. Like the other GitHub automations, provider access lives in the `github` integration connector and the logic lives here as data — there is no PR-specific backend code. Bundled with the GitHub integration alongside the Pull Request Reviewer agent.

parameters.instructions: Review the GitHub pull request named in the task. Use the GitHub integration to call get_pull_request_diff and get_pull_request_files for the diff and changed files, assess correctness, risk, and style, then post your verdict with create_pull_request_review using event REQUEST_CHANGES (if issues), APPROVE (if clean), or COMMENT (if only notes). Add inline comments for specific lines where useful. Do NOT merge. Summarize your review as a task comment and finish the task at in_review.
